note_to_reader: These four notes have been through an editing pass. The other notes in each family are printed with them, so a claim a note makes about a word beside it can be checked against that word's own note. Where the family prints a spectrum, its axis label is shown too, because that is the line the article renders above it.

senses.definition: the act of moving hurriedly and in a careless manner
senses.label: negative
senses.tone: Formal and weighty, naming the hurry as a fault to be answered for where *hurry* merely reports it.
examples: in his haste to leave he forgot his book
In his haste he knocked the cup off the table.
senses.axis: haste as plain fast movement → haste that turns careless and costs the mover dignity

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: the act of moving hurriedly and in a careless manner
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The plainest name for going fast and going badly at once, with the carelessness carried quietly rather than pressed.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: the act of moving hurriedly and in a careless manner
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Puts the weight on momentum - a harder-edged, more headlong version of *hurry*, where the speed is what overrides the care.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: the act of moving hurriedly and in a careless manner
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The participle keeps the careless speed running on as an activity rather than a single lapse, unlike the finished act *rush* names.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: the act of moving with great haste
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Great speed as a sudden break away, all abruptness and no blame - the carelessness that shadows *hurry* is absent.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: the act of moving with great haste
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Speed as a short spirited burst, brisk and deliberate beside the startled suddenness of *bolt*.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: rushing about hastily in an undignified way
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Makes the hurry small and skittering, so the loss of dignity comes out as comic rather than damning.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: rushing about hastily in an undignified way
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The undignified hurry as graceless floundering - effortful disorder where *scamper* is merely quick and silly.

senses.definition: (used of opinions and actions) far beyond the norm
senses.label: negative
senses.tone: Not just distance but too much distance - it drives an opinion or action past the limit its own position would have kept to, where *far* marks the same remove and leaves the verdict open.
senses.axis: registering a degree past the norm → denouncing it as past all reason

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: far more than usual or expected
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The one member whose excess can flatter, registering a degree far past what was expected as remarkable rather than as a fault.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: far more than usual or expected
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Sizes an excess by calling it a wrong, so the same far-more-than-expected that *extraordinary* admires becomes something to answer for.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: far beyond a norm in quantity or amount or degree; to an utmost degree
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Names the utmost degree flatly, measuring how far a quantity, amount or degree sits from the norm without ruling on whether that is a fault.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: beyond a norm in opinion or actions
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Purely positional: it sets an opinion or action out past the norm and leaves the verdict to whoever is looking, where *outrageous* is all verdict.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: complete or extreme
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Absolute rather than excessive, saying a thing is complete or extreme with nothing softening it, so its force is bleakness rather than blame.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: beyond normal limits
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Convicts the overstepping of having no argument for itself, a heavier charge than the plain over-the-limit of *excessive*.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: greatly exceeding bounds of reason or moderation
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Informal and dry, registering a large overshoot as a grumble rather than the protest that *outrageous* makes of the same gloss.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: beyond normal limits
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The flat statement of the case, that the limit has been passed, without the indignation *unreasonable* adds to it.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: beyond normal limits
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Formal and cool, sizing the overshoot rather than complaining about it as *unreasonable* does.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: greatly exceeding bounds of reason or moderation
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The hottest word here: the excess is treated as an affront, and the word demands that someone object.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: beyond normal limits
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Faults the excess for not being warranted rather than for its bulk, the quietest complaint among the words sharing its gloss.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: (used of opinions and actions) far beyond the norm
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Marks opinions and actions as standing well past the norm by commitment rather than by accident of degree, and eyes that commitment with reserve.

senses.definition: an elaborate and systematic plan of action
senses.label: neutral
senses.tone: The intricacy is what it adds - a plan worked out in enough system and detail that the design itself draws notice, where *system* names only the method for getting there.
examples: A scheme of which every part promises delight can never be successful
It would be such a delicious scheme, and I dare say would hardly cost anything at all.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: a preset plan of action in team sports
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Purely technical - a single move settled in advance and belonging to the team's game, passing no verdict on whether the plan is any good.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: a procedure or process for obtaining an objective
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The flattest member, a procedure or process identified only by the objective it is meant to obtain, with none of *scheme*'s insistence on intricacy.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: a plan of action adopted by an individual or social group
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Adoption is what it adds - the plan has been taken up and stands as the settled course of whoever holds it, one person as readily as a whole social group.

senses.label: positive
senses.tone: Stately and formal - it names her refinement as a standing she holds and is addressed by, where *ma'am* and *madam* pay the courtesy in passing.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: a woman of refinement
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The plain word for it — the refinement is granted without ceremony, where *gentlewoman* makes an occasion of it.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: a woman of refinement
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Deferential — respect offered to her rather than refinement described about her, and warmer than the starched *madam*.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: a woman of refinement
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Formal and ceremonious, the courtesy held at a polite distance where *ma'am* closes it.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: a woman of refinement
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The stateliest of the set — it treats refinement as her whole standing rather than a courtesy paid in passing.
